memo: New part on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU week quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits (T4 preflight, ICEBERG/GLACIER on CPU with 'budget' status allowed, smoke GPU checks off) and a last cell that drops scratch trees. Ours: where neither GLACIER nor ICEBERG gave a molecule any score, its final top 25 are re-ranked by z(-log rank) + 0.5 z(our 1-2 bond-cut fragment explanation of the spectra; ours_frag.py = port of our eval/fragexp.py). Idea source: ahmedberatozer v7c-e006-fraggap (code not used). On the CPU, ICEBERG scores fewer molecules, so this part covers more of them. Hypothesis: the fragment signal lifts molecules the forward models are blind to -> LB >= 0.441; compare with e3mmp100c-3 (same CPU base, MMP part).
message: e3fg05c-1: E006 0.440 base (CPU) + our fragment-explanation re-rank where ICE/GLACIER are blind (lambda 0.5). Hypothesis: LB >= 0.441
